en.headline: Officials install temporary signs to guide drivers for Route 6 opening
en.dek: More than 80 yellow temporary signs will help motorists adapt when the Kowloon Bay section of the Central Kowloon Bypass opens on 6 December, completing Route 6.
body: Transport officials are installing extra temporary signage ahead of the full opening of Route 6 on 6 December to help drivers navigate the new road layout.

Leung Sai-ho, Deputy Commissioner for Transport (planning and technical services), said more than 80 yellow temporary signs have been placed mainly at fork junctions, providing advance warnings 100 to 200 metres before lane-change points. He noted that the opening of the Yau Ma Tei section last year showed some drivers making late or dangerous lane changes.

The Kowloon Bay section is a 3.4-kilometre dual two-lane trunk road that includes a 3.1-kilometre tunnel. Its opening at 7am on 6 December will complete Route 6, linking Tseung Kwan O, Kowloon East and Kowloon West. Officials have also posted driving-guide videos and advised motorists to review routes in advance and allow extra time on the first working day after opening.

Leung said Hong Kong is a relatively small place, so drivers who choose the wrong lane can usually return to their destination quickly, but urged them not to violate traffic signs for convenience as it affects safety. Permanent blue signs will remain in use alongside the temporary yellow ones during the adaptation period.

zh.headline: 運輸署增設逾80個臨時路牌 助司機適應中九龍繞道九龍灣段開通
zh.dek: 九龍灣段將於12月6日早上7時開通，完成6號幹線，當局以黃色臨時路牌及導航影片協助駕駛者熟悉新路段。
body: 運輸署正加強臨時路牌及駕駛指引，以協助駕駛者適應中九龍繞道九龍灣段下月開通後的新道路布局。
運輸署副署長（規劃及技術服務）梁世豪表示，當局已設置逾80個黃色臨時路牌，主要擺放在分叉路口，於轉線點前約100至200米提供預告。他指出，去年油麻地段開通時已有駕駛者出現較遲或危險轉線的情況。
九龍灣段全長約3.4公里，包括3.1公里隧道，將於12月6日早上7時通車，標誌6號幹線全線完成，連接將軍澳、九龍東及九龍西。當局已上載駕駛指引影片，並呼籲駕駛者出發前先查閱路線，並在開通後首個工作日預留額外時間。
梁世豪表示，香港地方較小，即使選錯行車線通常可較快回到目的地，但呼籲切勿為一時方便而違反交通標誌，以免影響安全。黃色臨時路牌主要供適應期使用，原有藍色永久路牌會繼續保留。
